merchant_category_code.description: a list; when it is null, it means this fee applies to all merchant_category_code

references.matching: merchant_data.mcc should exactly match one of the values in this list

monthly_fraud_level.description: a range of percentage calculated by a merchant's fraudulent transaction number / total transaction number of that month; when it is null, it means this fee applies to all monthly_fraud_level

references.matching: need to calculate and match the percentage range

monthly_volume.description: a range of a merchant's total transaction amount of that month; when it is null, it means this fee applies to all monthly_volume

references.matching: need to calculate and match the range

is_credit.description: true or false; when it is null, it means this fee applies to all is_credit

intracountry.description: 1.0 when payments.issuing_country == payments.acquirer_country, 0.0 when payments.issuing_country != payments.acquirer_country; when it is null, it means this fee applies to all intracountry

references.matching: need to get the boolean value from payments.csv for matching

aci.description: a list; when it is empty, it means this fee applies to all aci

references.matching: payments.aci should exactly match one of the values in this list

account_type.description: a list; when it is empty, it means this fee applies to all account_type

references.matching: merchant_data.account_type should exactly match one of the values in this list

capture_delay.description: a range of int like '<3' '3-5' or a string like 'manual'. when it is null, it means this fee applies to all capture_delay

references.matching: when it is a range, need to check if the payment's capture_delay falls into that range; when it is a string, need to exactly match the string
